capabilities.label: Autonomous AI agents are the headline in every suite
capabilities.detail: — ServiceNow AI Agents, Zendesk AI Agents, Freddy, JSM Rovo, Intercom Fin, Salesforce Agentforce — all pitch full-resolution (~76–80%) bots with multi-step actions that read/write connected systems. **Outcome-based pricing** (pay per resolution) is emerging (Intercom Fin ~$0.99, Zendesk).

capabilities.label: Agent-assist copilots
capabilities.detail: universal — AI-drafted replies, tone/rewrite, summaries, next-best-action live in the workspace.

capabilities.label: Omnichannel inbox + unified routing
capabilities.detail: is table stakes — email/chat/async/WhatsApp/SMS/social/voice into one workspace with skills/capacity/priority routing. Voice/contact-center depth differentiates (Zendesk Talk, Service Cloud Voice, Freshcaller ship full telephony; Intercom/JSM lighter).

capabilities.label: ITSM depth (CMDB/change/problem/incident/discovery)

ServiceNow deepest; JSM differentiates on native DevOps/dev-tool integration.
